representation.name: BMI PR logistic regression AIC
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
Rscript - "$(inputs.input.path)" <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
d <- read.csv(args[[1]], check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
needed <- c("Efficacy", "BMI")
if (!all(needed %in% names(d))) stop("Required columns missing")
eff <- trimws(as.character(d[["Efficacy"]]))
bmi <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[["BMI"]]))
keep <- !is.na(eff) & eff != "" & !is.na(bmi)
y <- as.integer(eff[keep] == "PR")
x <- bmi[keep]
if (length(unique(y)) != 2L) stop("PR versus non-PR outcome is not binary in complete cases")
fit <- glm(y ~ x, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
vals <- c(
  method = "R stats::glm binomial(logit), maximum likelihood",
  formula = "I(Efficacy == 'PR') ~ BMI",
  event = "PR",
  non_event = "all non-PR Efficacy categories",
  n_complete = as.character(length(y)),
  n_pr = as.character(sum(y == 1L)),
  n_non_pr = as.character(sum(y == 0L)),
  coefficients = paste(format(coef(fit), digits = 17, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE), collapse = ","),
  log_likelihood = format(as.numeric(logLik(fit)), digits = 17, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE),
  aic = format(AIC(fit), digits = 17, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
)
out <- data.frame(metric = names(vals), value = unname(vals), check.names = FALSE)
write.table(out, file = "result.tsv", sep = "	", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, na = "")
RSCRIPT

representation.name: BMI logistic regression AIC for PR efficacy
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > job.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
d <- read.delim(args[1], header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
required <- c("Efficacy", "BMI")
if (!all(required %in% names(d))) {
  stop("Required columns Efficacy and BMI were not found")
}
eff <- trimws(as.character(d[["Efficacy"]]))
bmi <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[["BMI"]]))
keep <- !is.na(eff) & nzchar(eff) & !is.na(bmi)
analysis <- data.frame(
  response_PR = as.integer(eff[keep] == "PR"),
  BMI = bmi[keep]
)
if (nrow(analysis) == 0L) stop("No complete Efficacy/BMI rows")
if (length(unique(analysis$response_PR)) != 2L) stop("Binary outcome has fewer than two classes")
fit <- glm(response_PR ~ BMI, family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = analysis)
vals <- c(
  n_input = nrow(d),
  n_complete = nrow(analysis),
  n_PR = sum(analysis$response_PR == 1L),
  n_non_PR = sum(analysis$response_PR == 0L),
  df_model = attr(logLik(fit), "df"),
  logLik = as.numeric(logLik(fit)),
  AIC = AIC(fit)
)
out <- data.frame(metric = names(vals),
                  value = vapply(vals, function(x) format(x, digits = 17, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE), character(1)),
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.table(out, file = "result.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
RSCRIPT
